messages:
sarah_support: Customer 'Gamma' reported embedding shapes flipped after we pinned a newer variant. Before the pin their pipeline consumed shape (batch_size, 1024). After the pin they get something like (1024, batch_size) or occasionally a single long vector. Search scoring dropped to 0. Anybody seen an axis/transpose bug in embedding batching?

opsbot: Incident created INC-2026-487 (severity P2). https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-487

mike_ml: Can you paste the minimal repro / printed shapes? Is this one model id or across models?

sarah_support: It's specific to model 'openai-embed-2026-v2' pinned to variant 'v20260310-quant'. Minimal repro (python):

```
resp = client.embeddings(["a","b","c"])
vecs = np.array([d["embedding"] for d in resp["data"]])
print(vecs.shape)  # -> (1024, 3) expected (3, 1024)
```

Single-item calls return (1024,) as expected. The shape flip only when batch>1. Payload format looks like: { "data": [ {"embedding": [..]}, {"embedding": [..]}, ... ] } but stacking yields transposed array.

olga_infra: Please include x-request-id from response headers and the full model_version value. Also upload a small base64 sample of the response so infra can inspect serialization bytes.

sarah_support: request-id: r-0a1b2c3d4e; model_version: v20260310-quant. Uploaded base64 snippet and customer repro script to the ticket. They asked if we can rollback while we triage.

jordan_se: Likely causes: 1) server batching code concatenates along wrong axis; 2) serialization switching row/column-major for quantized kernels; 3) client library expecting different nesting. Quick check: can you run a batch of size 2 with identical inputs and diff the two returned arrays (elementwise)? If values are identical but axes swapped that's a pack-order bug.

sarah_support: Confirmed: values correspond to expected vectors but axes swapped — elementwise compare shows value at [i,j] equals expected [j,i]. Happens only when batch>1. Assigning to @mike_ml to triage server pack/stack logic.

mike_ml: I'll reproduce against the quantized variant locally and check pack_batch_dims -> stack order and any kernel-level transpose. ETA ~3h. If it's a regression in the pinned variant we can pin back the prior variant.

olga_infra: Rollback is available for the customer's reserved pool. Scheduling immediate rollback now and notifying the customer.

sarah_support: Thanks — customer accepts rollback for now. Keeping thread open for root-cause and fix plan.
